files.title: File:Champ's Ford Bridge, downstream side.jpg
files.author: Nyttend
files.caption: Southern (downstream) side of the Champ's Ford Bridge, which carries Road 100S over Clifty Creek west of Burney in Clay Township, Decatur County, Indiana, United States.  Built in 1904, it is listed on the National Register of Historic Places.
